attributes.name: hand_near_mouth
attributes.text: A hand comes up to the mouth and stays close to it.
attributes.definition: The hand joint reaches the front of the lower face at mouth level and remains there for at least a short moment. Count it when the hand is in front of the mouth, not beside the ear or on top of the head.

attributes.name: hand_near_nose_or_face_center
attributes.text: One or both hands touch the middle of the face around the nose or eyes.
attributes.definition: A hand is at the center of the face above the mouth level, around the nose or eyes. Hands at the sides of the head or at the mouth do not count.

attributes.name: hand_on_top_of_head
attributes.text: A hand is placed on the top of the head.
attributes.definition: The hand joint reaches the crown of the head, above the ears. Count it when the hand rests on or moves over the top of the head.

attributes.name: hand_at_side_of_head
attributes.text: A hand touches the side of the head near the ear or temple.
attributes.definition: The hand joint is beside the head at ear or temple level, touching or nearly touching it. Hands in front of the face or on the crown do not count.

attributes.name: hand_at_back_of_neck
attributes.text: A hand reaches behind the head to the back of the neck.
attributes.definition: The hand joint moves behind the head and stays near the neck from the back, with the elbow pointing forward or up.

attributes.name: both_hands_touching
attributes.text: The two hands touch each other in front of the body.
attributes.definition: The left and right hand joints come into contact in front of the torso, either once or repeatedly. Hands that are only near each other with a gap do not count.

attributes.name: active_hand_meets_still_hand
attributes.text: One hand stays still while the other hand repeatedly moves to it.
attributes.definition: One hand (usually the left) holds a fixed position and the other hand moves onto, across, or around it. The two hands play different roles.

attributes.name: hand_on_chest
attributes.text: A hand or forearm is pressed against the front of the chest.
attributes.definition: A hand or forearm rests on the torso at chest level and stays there. Hands held in front of the chest with space between them and the body do not count.

attributes.name: hand_on_hip_or_lower_back
attributes.text: A hand is placed at the hip, upper thigh, or lower back.
attributes.definition: The hand joint moves to the side of the hip, the upper thigh, or the lower back and stays there briefly or for longer.

attributes.name: hands_reach_foot
attributes.text: The hands reach down to touch a foot.
attributes.definition: One or both hand joints come close to an ankle or foot joint. Hands near the floor but away from the feet do not count.

attributes.name: forearms_cross
attributes.text: The two forearms cross or overlap in front of the body.
attributes.definition: The left and right forearms pass over each other in front of the chest or face so each hand ends on the opposite side of the body, or one hand holds the other wrist or arm.

attributes.name: head_moves_toward_hand
attributes.text: The head moves down or forward to meet a raised hand.
attributes.definition: While a hand is held near the face, the head dips or bends toward it, reducing the distance between head and hand from the head side.
